# ZeePay

> Payment gateway for African businesses. Merchants accept EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Omari, cards (Visa/Mastercard via ZimSwitch) and bank transfers through one REST API. ZeePay can also act as the merchant's product back-store: products are created in ZeePay and pulled into the merchant's own storefront.

## Key facts

- Base URL: `https://api.zeepay.co.zw/v1`
- Auth: `X-API-Key` header. `zp_test_*` keys hit sandbox (no real money), `zp_live_*` keys hit production.
- Secret keys are server-side only — never expose them in client-side code.
- Checkout is hosted: create a payment server-side, redirect the customer to `checkoutUrl`.
- Webhooks sign payloads with `X-ZeePay-Signature: sha256=<hmac-sha256(payload, secret)>`.
- All create operations support idempotency keys to prevent duplicates.

## Docs

- [Full integration guide](/llms-full.txt): complete API surface, request/response shapes, integration recipes
- [OpenAPI 3 spec](/openapi.yaml): machine-readable spec — feed to openapi-generator/orval/openapi-typescript to generate typed clients in any language
- [Human docs](/docs): API reference tables and quickstart
- [Node.js/TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/Munyah17/ZeePay-Gateway/tree/master/sdk): `npm install zeepay-sdk`
